'''Purification Unit''' is an [[AIC]] [[Facilities|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|A facility for raising the purity of various solutions.|"My friend, you understand, right? Our alchemical arts have had a splendorous history. Just look at the starry cosmos outside... This place should not be the end of our conquests and achievements! I need a better place! An optimized, stable, and Originium-rich environment!" 
"Is that your excuse for almost breaching the hull of Dijiang with explosives?"}}

A facility for raising the purity of various solutions.
